kids.t: Target = Normalarbeitszeit on working days; public holidays are free, half days (in Austria 24 and 31 December) count half. Vacation, sick and doctor entries (project hr) count as worked. ± month is worked minus target. Overtime balance and vacation carry over from the first hours period, opening balances included.
An entry with several tags counts once in every subtotal, but under each of its tags; entries without a tag are under —.
Every tag belongs to one project. Typing an unknown #tag creates it on the entry’s project.
